journey.setup: Use the existing synthetic DP780 Test Data fixture and the current Modeling/Materials routes; no permanent demo data mutation.
actions: Open the exact selected Test Data and revision in Modeling Data, continue through Process, Fit and Export, and read back the same state after reload.
Separately open the seeded elastomer Fit route, read the exact Neutral Material revision, run mapping preflight, and inspect the actual Neutral mapping-report producer.

Exercise the retained hyperelastic chart-axis/chart-tick hold and confirm its 12px producer cascade remains unchanged.
Compare before/after originals and direct crops at each required CSS viewport with browser zoom fixed at 100%.
journey.visible_outcome: The existing flat Materials/Modeling hierarchy, graph/preview bounds, controls, copy and reachability remain unchanged after ownership relocation.
journey.persistence_readback: Exact Material, State, Test Data, revision and Modeling stage/session state read back through the existing route and reload contracts.
journey.recovery: Blocked, stale and invalid exact revisions preserve the existing fail-closed recovery actions and route reachability; server-dependent recovery capture is source-tested when the disposable fixture supplies an exact route.
negative_cases: The retained hyperelastic chart rules remain in styles.css and do not appear in a feature owner stylesheet.
Mixed source groups keep their non-target peer selector and declaration order.
Feature CSS is imported once by its truthful consumer and before layout.css where cascade requires it.
technical_cases: The producer partition records Neutral mapping as a rendered elastomer Fit journey; metal elastoplastic and polymer linear-viscoelastic mapping consumers are explicitly unreachable through the supported product routes and remain unclaimed.
The deterministic M1E5 source oracle proves the legacy complement, owner identity/signature, source order, at-context and complete/mixed boundaries.
The CSS inventory and frontend guard record 1,391 legacy selector rows and 1,184 legacy rule groups after the move.
Production and Storybook bundle evidence was inspected in the final Main packet; browser zoom is 100% at DPR1, while physical Windows 4K readability remains deferred to #223.
